correctness.rationale: For p_N=d_N/N→p∈(0,1), m_N=ceil(α log N) with fixed α>0, the binomial lower tail at t≈β_N log N has a geometric endpoint factor and saddle prefactor (log N)^(-1/2). The unique β_N>α/p_N solves β_N D(α/β_N||p_N)=1 and the time-shift exponent is s_N=-log((1-p_N)β_N/(β_N-α))>0, giving b_N=β_N log N-(log log N)/(2s_N)+O(1). Uniform fixed-h coupon inclusion-pattern likelihood ratios are 1+O_h(log N/N) over O(log N) rounds, enough at probability N^-h for Poisson deficient-count factorial moments. Negative covariance of two below-quota indicators and geometric tail ratios control both time tails, yielding uniform discrete-Gumbel CDF and o(1) expectation/variance via uniform integrability. Boundary p in (0,1) and fixed α are required. Exact finite pattern and binomial identities checked; no finite test establishes the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The required quota m_N≈αlog N is the natural boundary where binomial large deviations of one coupon drive extreme completion in a constant integer-round window. The -0.5 log log N correction exceeds the scale of the final fluctuation: omitting it yields an incorrect completion probability. The phase-dependent lattice law and additive o(1) moment formulas quantify repeated positive-fraction batch sampling, a motivated problem not answered by fixed-quota collection.
